capabilities: Translate tapped or selected text using Google Translate
Add a translate button to the mobile toolbar
Generate context sentences with a Gemini API key
Configure a Cloud Translation API key as a fallback when translation fails
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also works on desktop, not just mobile.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes setup steps for a paid Google Cloud API whose free tier covers under 0.5M characters per month.
motivation: The author values the consistency Google Translate provides over AI translation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly translate a selected or tapped word, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: Tap or Select the desired word to get it's translation from Google Translate
If you want to generate context sentences: Grab your Gemini API key

requires.name: Google Cloud billing account (only if setting up the Cloud Translation API)

summary: Translation plugin that translates tapped or selected words via Google Translate on mobile and desktop, with optional AI context sentences.
